book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: عامل بمصنع كان بيربي حصان عجوز.
sentences.en: A factory worker kept an old horse.

sentences.ar: الحصان صار ما بيشتغل، بس ما باعه.
sentences.en: The horse had stopped working, but he did not sell it.

sentences.ar: مرته قالت: بنطعمي حيوان ما بينفع.
sentences.en: His wife said: we are feeding an animal that is no use.

sentences.ar: هو قال: هاد شغل معي عشرين سنة.
sentences.en: He said: this one worked with me twenty years.
The neighbours began laughing at him.

sentences.ar: قالوا: بيصرف على حصان زي ما بيصرف على ولد.
sentences.en: They said: he spends on a horse as he would on a child.
In a harsh winter, the horse fell ill and died.
The man sat in the stable all night.

sentences.ar: الصبح، مرته سألته: شو بتعمل هون؟
sentences.en: In the morning, his wife asked him: what are you doing here?

sentences.ar: قال: ولا إشي. بس المحل صار واسع.
sentences.en: He said: nothing. Only, the place has become large.
